description: Container logs from any stack: keep a fixed set of top-level fields and move everything else (parsed app JSON) into the flat_object 'fields'. Prevents mapping explosion and type conflicts that would make the shipper retry a chunk forever.

script.description: containers-<stack>-<env>-<date>: fill stack/env when the shipper did not send them
script.source: String i = ctx._index; if (i.startsWith('containers-')) { String[] p = i.substring(11).splitOnToken('-'); if (p.length >= 3) { if (ctx.stack == null) { ctx.stack = p[0]; } if (ctx.env == null) { ctx.env = p[1]; } } }

script.description: Docker's fluentd driver sends container_name as '/name'

json.if: ctx.log instanceof String && ctx.log.startsWith('{') && ctx.message == null

script.description: Generic shippers send the raw line; lift common keys from app JSON, keep the rest for fields.*
script.source: Map p = ctx._parsed; ctx.remove('_parsed'); for (String k : ['message','msg']) { if (ctx.message == null && p.containsKey(k)) { ctx.message = p.remove(k); } } for (String k : ['level','severity','lvl']) { if (ctx.level == null && p.containsKey(k)) { ctx.level = p.remove(k); } } for (String k : ['request_id','requestId','req_id']) { if (ctx.request_id == null && p.containsKey(k)) { ctx.request_id = p.remove(k); } } for (def e : p.entrySet()) { if (!ctx.containsKey(e.getKey())) { ctx[e.getKey()] = e.getValue(); } } ctx.remove('log');

Map extra = ctx.containsKey('fields') && ctx.fields instanceof Map ? ctx.fields : new HashMap(); List move = new ArrayList(); for (String k : ctx.keySet()) { if (!k.startsWith('_') && !params.core.contains(k)) { move.add(k); } } for (String k : move) { extra.put(k, ctx.remove(k)); } if (!extra.isEmpty()) { ctx.fields = extra; } if (ctx.level != null && !(ctx.level instanceof String)) { ctx.level = String.valueOf(ctx.level); } if (ctx.message != null && !(ctx.message instanceof String)) { ctx.message = String.valueOf(ctx.message); } if (ctx.message == null && ctx.log instanceof String) { ctx.message = ctx.log; } if (ctx.log != null && ctx.message != null && ctx.log == ctx.message) { ctx.remove('log'); }

script.description: Plain-text lines (OpenSearch, postgres, nginx, ...) carry their level in the text; detect the common markers so level filters work for every container
script.source: String m = ctx.message.length() > 200 ? ctx.message.substring(0, 200) : ctx.message; String u = m.toUpperCase(); List marks = [['fatal','[FATAL',' FATAL:','LEVEL=FATAL','PANIC:'], ['error','[ERROR',' ERROR:','LEVEL=ERROR','[ERR]'], ['warn','[WARN',' WARNING:','LEVEL=WARN'], ['info','[INFO',' LOG:','LEVEL=INFO',' INFO:'], ['debug','[DEBUG','LEVEL=DEBUG',' DEBUG:','[TRACE']]; for (def mk : marks) { for (int i = 1; i < mk.size(); i++) { if (u.contains(mk.get(i))) { ctx.level = mk.get(0); return; } } }
